departments.name: General Medicine & Family Health
departments.shortDescription: Comprehensive acute illness management, chronic disease prevention, and regular health assessments.
departments.description: Our General Medicine department provides holistic primary care, fever management, diabetes & hypertension monitoring, and routine medical screenings for all family members.

departments.name: Pediatrics & Child Wellness
departments.shortDescription: Gentle, attentive clinical care for newborns, infants, children, and adolescents.
departments.description: Expert pediatricians providing newborn screenings, developmental milestone assessments, pediatric nutrition, and seasonal infection care.

departments.name: Cardiology & Preventive Heart Care
departments.shortDescription: Cardiac risk evaluation, diagnostic ECG, blood pressure regulation, and lifestyle cardiology.
departments.description: Focusing on early detection of cardiovascular risks, hypertension management, cholesterol monitoring, and non-invasive cardiac screenings.

departments.name: Obstetrics & Gynecology
departments.shortDescription: Compassionate women’s health across every phase of life, antenatal consultation, and wellness.
departments.description: Specialized healthcare dedicated to maternal wellness, antenatal counseling, PCOS/PCOD management, routine screening, and menopausal health.

departments.name: Orthopedics & Joint Care
departments.shortDescription: Diagnosis and conservative management of bone, joint, ligament, and spine conditions.
departments.description: Comprehensive bone health evaluation, arthritis pain management, postural correction, osteopenia screening, and post-injury rehabilitation advice.

services.name: Comprehensive Health & Preventive Checkup
services.nameBn: সার্বিক স্বাস্থ্য পরীক্ষা ও প্রতিরোধমূলক চেকআপ
services.shortDescription: Full clinical evaluation including complete blood count, blood sugar, lipid profile, liver & kidney panels, and doctor consultation.
services.description: CareOn’s signature preventive health evaluation package structured to detect early markers of metabolic and lifestyle conditions with complete clinical review.
preparationInstructions: Overnight fasting of 8-10 hours required for fasting glucose and lipid panel.
Bring recent medication details and previous medical reports.

services.name: 12-Lead Diagnostic ECG & Rhythm Evaluation
services.shortDescription: High-precision digital 12-lead Electrocardiogram interpreted by our consultant cardiologists.
services.description: Immediate non-invasive electrical heart rhythm tracing for evaluating chest discomfort, palpitations, breathlessness, or pre-operative medical fitness.
preparationInstructions: Wear loose, comfortable clothing for easy chest electrode placement.

services.name: Child Wellness & Growth Assessment
services.nameBn: শিশু স্বাস্থ্য ও শারীরিক বৃদ্ধি মূল্যায়ন
services.shortDescription: Detailed developmental milestones check, height-weight percentile mapping, and nutritional guidance.
services.description: Structured pediatrician-led examination for monitoring child physical growth, vision & hearing reflexes, motor skill development, and immunization schedule verification.
preparationInstructions: Bring child’s immunization record book and birth records.
Prepare any specific dietary or sleep concerns beforehand.

services.name: Women’s Wellness & Antenatal Care
services.shortDescription: Personalized clinical consultations for expectant mothers, hormonal balance, and preventative gynecological screenings.
services.description: CareOn provides private, empathetic clinical care for mothers-to-be, trimester-by-trimester health monitoring, and routine pelvic wellness checks.
preparationInstructions: Bring previous ultrasound reports and current prescription sheets.
Consultation does not require prior fasting.

services.name: Doorstep Blood Sample & Lab Collection
services.nameBn: বাড়ি থেকে ব্লাড স্যাম্পল ও ল্যাব কালেকশন
services.shortDescription: Trained phlebotomist visit to your home for safe, hygienic blood, urine and routine diagnostic sample pickup.
services.description: Hygienic, temperature-controlled doorstep diagnostic sample collection across Contai and surrounding localities for elderly or bedridden patients.
preparationInstructions: Keep patient resting comfortably prior to sample draw.
Confirm if fasting is required for the requested panel.

services.name: Home Nursing & Vital Signs Monitoring
services.nameBn: হোম নার্সিং ও ভাইটাল মনিটরিং সেবা
services.shortDescription: Professional at-home vital sign monitoring (BP, Blood Glucose, SpO2), injection administration, and dressing changes.
services.description: Certified healthcare assistant home visits for post-discharge wound dressing, regular blood pressure optimization, insulin education, and basic patient care support.
preparationInstructions: Keep recent doctor prescription sheets ready for the nursing attendant.
